title: Crystal phase and band edge modulation of MA- and Br-free CsFA-based perovskites for efficient inverted solar cells and minimodules
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1732-1744
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05860G, Paper
Jiewei Yang, Qi Wang, Wei Hui, Xin Chen, Yuqi Yao, Weijian Tang, Wuke Qiu, Xiaopeng Xu, Lin Song, Yihui Wu, Qiang Peng
A Lewis base is selected to regulate crystal growth, reduce δ-phase formation and inhibit halide oxidation of perovskites, enabling champion efficiencies of 26.12% for a 0.09-cm2 inverted device and 22.67% for a 12.96-cm2 minimodule, respectively.
